summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K reporting the 38th monthly Series D preferred redemption date on November 5, 2026, processing three requests for 1,903 Series D shares at roughly $41.80 per share, settled by issuing 74,374 common shares. The lowest Series D conversion price was about $1.07, triggering an indenture adjustment cutting the 7.00% Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2031 conversion price to roughly $0.59, a 45% discount. Cumulative redemptions total 453 requests and 1,834,581 preferred shares; 1,862,906 common and 1,723,288 Series D remain outstanding. Watch continued dilution and note overhang.
